text: Alex ruled: we are underutilizing everything at our AI disposal to get this accomplished. Better to test an idea on a generation than to speculate about it.

Utilization push: fired full scene rollout on 5090 (build_scenes --all: 14 Qwen scene stills composed, 32B review 12 GOOD/11 BAD, pass-B H3 renders running; BAD set envoys/juliana/nekron/roliel/shaitan/spirit/teegra — metal armour bleed + hand blobs + weapon grip) and T0020 base-model sweep on 4090 (taro, 60/60 GOOD incl 4 new bases). Mined 10 Reddit threads on Qwen-Image-Edit prompting -> docs/qwen-edit-prompting-guides.md + index; doctrine: identity clause AFTER action, ref-by-slot 'person in image 1', 'same person', 'this background', chain small edits, Consistence LoRA civitai 1939453. T0026 A/B driver runs/build_t0026_recompose.py re-composing the 7 BAD chars + taro control with template-b. ACCIDENT+RECOVERY: fat-fingered skill_manage delete destroyed the fni-h3-pipeline skill; SKILL.md restored verbatim from session cache, 6/11 reference files recovered from state.db history, 5 lost (comfyui-gotchas/lora-sourcing/scene-scoping/setups/wardrobe-extraction) replaced by honest stubs pointing at in-repo substance; full skills backup zip in hermes/backups.

YOLO full-movie run fired (Alex: 'MAKE THE WHOLE MOVIE YOLO'). runs/yolo_full_movie.py orchestrates: per scene, vlm_blocking (goldfishbowl 32B/literal --write) then queue all chunks via build_technicolor_audio_only --queue (REF2VA audio-only, T0016 mode) on the 5090; resumable via runs/yolo_state.json, preseeded S03/S05 (T0016/17). Coverage fix mid-run: sheet_path glob {name}_sheet_t*.png missed NEKRON (sheet6 naming), ENVOY (only ENVOYS had one), LARN (png never pulled — re-rendered from its t01 graph after fixing stale lora path krea/ -> 'Krea 2/style/' post-sort): renderable chunks 169 -> 256/494. Remaining ~238 skips = the G-scene group-character sheet gap (GUARDS/RIDERS/VILLAGE CHIEF/ELDER/SUBHUMANS, NARRATOR voice-only) — needs frame mining + sheet gen. NOTE: chunks sheet-skipped BEFORE the fix are marked skipped in yolo_state; clear those entries and re-run --queue-only after the pass drains. 4090 in parallel: re-sweeping weak chars nekron/subhuman/envoys/shaitan/spirit (gens 4 x 4 bases) + review. T0026 qwb recomposes still interleaved on 5090 queue.

YOLO run STOPPED by Alex ('blocking and character refs way off — stop the video gens, extract frames, VLM on goldfishbowl'). Orchestrator killed, 5090 queue purged+interrupted (7 audioOnly renders already done, pulled to runs/yolo_diag/). ROOT CAUSES found: (1) manifests/blocking.json is 487/493 ERR strings — vlm_blocking.py --write wrote TRANSPORT ERRORS as blocking text when goldfishbowl refused connections (same bug class as the review-ledger ERROR rule, not yet applied there); those ERR strings went into every queued prompt. (2) 32B frame audit of the 7 renders: CROWDS in every clip (3-25 duplicated warrior-women extras) despite GLOBAL_CONSTRAINT — the constraint is an intimate-interior string and wrong for G crowd scenes; (3) register instability (G02-c01 2D/3D hybrid Nekron); (4) several verdicts describe the TEEGRA sheet as showing a BROWN LEATHER warrior outfit vs her purple canon — possible non-canon panel on the sheet feeding the crowd costume, needs an eyeball; (5) ledger subjects for G crowd scenes list TEEGRA only — one-sheet-per-subject cannot pin a 20-extra scene. Diag: runs/yolo_diag/diag_results.jsonl. Fixes owed: strip ERR from blocking.json + skip-not-write on transport error in vlm_blocking; per-scene crowd/intimate constraint; VLM-derived cast for group scenes.

Guardrails added per Alex ('can we add checks to catch this'): core/prompt_guards.py (looks_like_error/usable_blocking/lint_prompt — 'an error string is not content' for ANY ledger/prompt/manifest). Three gates: (1) vlm_blocking.py skip-not-write on VLM failure + exit 1 on partial; (2) build_technicolor_audio_only.py drops poisoned blocking, lints the prompt, REFUSES to queue G## group scenes without usable blocking (--force overrides); (3) yolo_full_movie.py re-verifies a scene's blocking landed usable before queueing it. blocking.json healed 494->7 real entries (487 ERRs stripped); yolo_state scene flags cleared + 219 tainted queued entries dropped so a re-run re-drafts and re-queues clean. Verified live: G03-c02 refused without blocking, S05-c01 dry-run passes lint, vlm_blocking drafted real blocking for G03-c02 (goldfishbowl up). Note: the fni-h3-pipeline SKILL.md on disk is NEWER than my session restore — another session is co-maintaining it and had already absorbed the incident lessons; I only added the gates paragraph.

Alex: 'twice we have failed for bad script error handling — how can we not have this happen'. The two burns: vlm_blocking wrote ERR strings into blocking.json (no content validation at the writer), and yolo_full_movie called vlm_blocking WITHOUT --endpoint (defaulted to dead LM Studio branch, failed soft; the run charged on). Structural answer, implemented: yolo_full_movie.py now has preflight() (goldfishbowl reachable AND qwen3-vl-32b-heretic loaded; 5090 answers and is linux; blocking.json ERR-free; source-pinned --endpoint goldfishbowl regression check) that aborts the run on any failure; FAIL-STOP on a bad drafting pass (scene's chunks skipped, never fed to queueing); circuit breakers: 2 consecutive failed scene passes or 8 consecutive queue failures abort the run loudly. Failures log the last 10 lines, not one. Relaunched (pid 23252), preflight OK, G02 blocking drafting. Rule of thumb now in skill: validate inputs at the stage boundary, fail loud, never let a stage eat another stage's wreckage.

Alex: use idle compute — 'why aren't we looking at the errors with a smaller model on goldfishbowl'. Deployed tools/log_watcher.py (detached, 3-min polls): diff-tails runs/yolo_full_movie.log, triages every failure with qwen3-vl-8b-abl (benign/guard/transient/novel), runs a qwen3-coder:30b root-cause read against the driver source for NOVEL failures only, and relaunches the orchestrator if it dies with work pending (PowerShell CIM liveness — wmic is gone on Win11; pending = failed>0 or tracked<494, never the stale DONE line). Digest: runs/yolo_diag/watcher_digest.jsonl; OptMem only on death/circuit events. Goldfishbowl inventory (much more than the 32B VL): qwen3-vl-8b-abl 6GB, qwen3-coder:30b 18.6GB, huihui qwen3-coder-abliterated:30b, qwen3.5-35b-a3b (MoE), llama3.3-70b, magnum-v4-72b, gemma-4-26b-qat, cydonia-24b-q8, qwen3.8-27b-rvn x3, terse-coder 22GB.
log_watcher: orchestrator was dead with work pending — relaunched pid 2284; ORCHESTRATOR DEAD

Third 'fart out': BOTH detached helpers (orchestrator + watcher) died silently ~22:03-22:05 — session-children are not durable; also 25 finished renders sat unpulled on the 5090 (/history wipes on reboot) and goldfishbowl's 32B got swapped out by another user mid-scene-pass. Durable answer deployed: log_watcher.py hardened (lockfile so concurrent pollers collide safely; pull_new_renders collects every finished audioOnly mp4 to runs/yolo_output/ each poll; PowerShell CIM liveness) and now driven by TWO independent schedulers instead of session children: Windows Task Scheduler 'FNI-yolo-watcher' every 5 min (survives session death AND reboots) + Hermes cron daa5dc487363 (every 5m, no-agent, script fni_yolo_watch.py, deliver local). Verified end-to-end: watcher detected the dead orchestrator, relaunched it (preflight OK, G03 drafting resumed), pulled 26 renders to E:, forced cron run succeeded. Rule: NOTHING long-lived may be a session child — schedule it.

Utilization fix (Alex: 'farted out again, why arent the 5090 and 4090 getting used'): the 5090 sat idle ~1h while G03's 56-chunk blocking drafted because queueing was serialized BEHIND drafting per scene. Architecture split: yolo_full_movie.py now runs as TWO supervised daemons — blocker (--block-only, goldfishbowl-bound scene drafting, partial scene coverage counts: usable>0 = blocked, stragglers stay untracked rather than re-drafting) and feeder (--queue-only --loop, rescans every 120s and queues every chunk whose blocking is ready; G-chunks without blocking are skipped untracked, not failed). log_watcher supervises BOTH roles (blocker/feeder liveness via distinct cmdline patterns, relaunches whichever dies; legacy single-orchestrator tolerated). Effect: 5090 FIFO now holds 101 pending renders ~10h of work while drafting continues ahead of it. Also resolved the 'two orchestrators' scare: pid 2284 was the uv-venv redirector shim of the one real orchestrator (41096), not a duplicate. Committed 8594b94.
